```{r}
#Studi Kasus 2: Analisis Hubungan Inflasi, Suku Bunga dan Kurs Rupiah (VAR/VECM) 
# Muhammad Hafidz Ar Rasyid Hutagalung
# 222413683
# 2KS3

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tseries)   # adf.test, pp.test
library(urca)      # ur.df, ur.pp, ur.kpss, ca.jo
library(vars)      # VARselect, VAR, irf, fevd, stability
library(lmtest)    # diagnostik tambahan
library(zoo)       # yearmon

set.seed(123)

data <- read_excel("D:/Tugas/S4/ARW/dataUASno2.xlsx")

data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    bulan   = as.Date(paste0(bulan, "-01")),
    ln_kurs = log(kursrp)          # log natural, bukan log10
  ) %>%
  arrange(bulan)

# Cek struktur & kualitas data
str(data)
summary(data)
colSums(is.na(data))
sum(duplicated(data$bulan))
nrow(data)                         

# Objek time series
data_ts <- ts(data[, c("inflasi", "birate", "ln_kurs")],
              start = c(2011, 1), frequency = 12)

# Stats deskriptif
stat_desc <- data %>%
  summarise(
    across(c(inflasi, birate, ln_kurs),
           list(mean = mean, sd = sd, min = min, max = max),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}")
  )
print(stat_desc)

# Visualisasi
plot_series <- function(y, title, ylab, color = "steelblue") {
  ggplot(data.frame(waktu = as.numeric(time(y)), nilai = as.numeric(y)),
         aes(waktu, nilai)) +
    geom_line(color = color) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Tahun", y = ylab)
}

p1 <- plot_series(data_ts[, "inflasi"], "Inflasi Bulanan (%)", "Inflasi")
p2 <- plot_series(data_ts[, "birate"],  "BI Rate (%)",          "BI Rate", "firebrick")
p3 <- plot_series(data_ts[, "ln_kurs"], "Ln Kurs Rp/USD",       "ln(Kurs)", "darkgreen")

print(p1); print(p2); print(p3)

# Uji Stasioneritas: ADF, PP, KPSS
# Fungsi bantu ADF 3 tipe 
uji_adf <- function(x, nama) {
  none  <- ur.df(x, type = "none",  selectlags = "AIC")
  drift <- ur.df(x, type = "drift", selectlags = "AIC")
  trend <- ur.df(x, type = "trend", selectlags = "AIC")
  cat("\n=== ADF:", nama, "===\n")
  cat(sprintf("none : stat = %7.4f | CV5%% = %7.4f\n",
              none@teststat[1],  none@cval[1, 2]))
  cat(sprintf("drift: stat = %7.4f | CV5%% = %7.4f\n",
              drift@teststat[1], drift@cval[1, 2]))
  cat(sprintf("trend: stat = %7.4f | CV5%% = %7.4f\n",
              trend@teststat[1], trend@cval[1, 2]))
  invisible(list(none = none, drift = drift, trend = trend))
}

#Fungsi bantu PP + KPSS 
uji_pp_kpss <- function(x, nama) {
  pp   <- ur.pp(x,   type = "Z-tau", model = "constant", lags = "short")
  kpss <- ur.kpss(x, type = "mu",    lags = "short")
  cat("\n=== PP & KPSS:", nama, "===\n")
  cat(sprintf("PP  : stat = %7.4f | CV5%% = %7.4f\n",
              pp@teststat[1],  pp@cval[1, 2]))
  cat(sprintf("KPSS: stat = %7.4f | CV5%% = %7.4f\n",
              kpss@teststat[1], kpss@cval[1, 2]))
  invisible(list(pp = pp, kpss = kpss))
}

# Level
adf_inf_lvl   <- uji_adf(data$inflasi, "Inflasi (level)")
adf_bir_lvl   <- uji_adf(data$birate,  "BI Rate (level)")
adf_lnk_lvl   <- uji_adf(data$ln_kurs, "ln Kurs (level)")

pp_kpss_inf_lvl <- uji_pp_kpss(data$inflasi, "Inflasi (level)")
pp_kpss_bir_lvl <- uji_pp_kpss(data$birate,  "BI Rate (level)")
pp_kpss_lnk_lvl <- uji_pp_kpss(data$ln_kurs, "ln Kurs (level)")

# First difference
d_inflasi <- diff(data$inflasi)
d_birate  <- diff(data$birate)
d_lnkurs  <- diff(data$ln_kurs)

adf_inf_diff <- uji_adf(d_inflasi, "D.Inflasi")
adf_bir_diff <- uji_adf(d_birate,  "D.BI Rate")
adf_lnk_diff <- uji_adf(d_lnkurs,  "D.ln Kurs")

pp_kpss_inf_diff <- uji_pp_kpss(d_inflasi, "D.Inflasi")
pp_kpss_bir_diff <- uji_pp_kpss(d_birate,  "D.BI Rate")
pp_kpss_lnk_diff <- uji_pp_kpss(d_lnkurs,  "D.ln Kurs")


# Uji Kointegrasi Johansen (BI Rate & ln Kurs)
I1_data <- data %>% dplyr::select(birate, ln_kurs)

# Tentukan lag optimal untuk Johansen
lag_opt_I1 <- VARselect(I1_data, lag.max = 12, type = "const")
print(lag_opt_I1$selection)
K_joh <- as.numeric(lag_opt_I1$selection["AIC(n)"])

# Trace & Eigen (robustness check)
joh_trace <- ca.jo(I1_data, type = "trace", ecdet = "const",
                   K = K_joh, spec = "transitory")
joh_eigen <- ca.jo(I1_data, type = "eigen", ecdet = "const",
                   K = K_joh, spec = "transitory")

summary(joh_trace)
summary(joh_eigen)

# Membentuk Dataset untuk VAR (3 variabel)
var_dataset <- data.frame(
  bulan    = data$bulan[-1],
  inflasi  = data$inflasi[-1],   # I(0)
  d_birate = d_birate,           # I(1) -> diff
  d_lnkurs = d_lnkurs            # I(1) -> diff
)

Y_var <- var_dataset %>% dplyr::select(inflasi, d_birate, d_lnkurs)

# Penentuan Lag Optimal VAR
lag_select <- VARselect(Y_var, lag.max = 12, type = "const")
print(lag_select$selection)
print(lag_select$criteria)
p_opt <- as.numeric(lag_select$selection["AIC(n)"])
cat("Lag optimal (AIC):", p_opt, "\n")

# Estimasi Model VAR
var_model <- VAR(Y_var, p = p_opt, type = "const")
summary(var_model)

# Uji Stabilitas
roots_val <- roots(var_model)
cat("Modulus Roots:\n"); print(Mod(roots_val))
cat("Max modulus:", max(Mod(roots_val)), "(harus < 1)\n")

par(mar = c(5, 5, 4, 2))
plot(stability(var_model))

# Diagnostik Residual
serial_test    <- serial.test(var_model, lags.pt = 12, type = "PT.asymptotic")
normality_test <- normality.test(var_model, multivariate.only = TRUE)
arch_test      <- vars::arch.test(var_model, lags.multi = 12, multivariate.only = TRUE)

print(serial_test)
print(normality_test)
print(arch_test)

# Cttn: Jika normalitas ditolak (umum pada data keuangan),
# IRF & FEVD tetap valid selama:
#   - tidak ada autokorelasi residual (serial test p > 0.05)
#   - model stabil (semua root < 1)
# Non-normalitas hanya memengaruhi inferensi koefisien VAR (uji-t),
# bukan IRF/FEVD yang berbasis simulasi bootstrap.

# Impulse Response Function (IRF)
buat_irf <- function(model, impulse_var, response_var, n_ahead = 24) {
  res <- irf(model, impulse = impulse_var, response = response_var,
             n.ahead = n_ahead, ortho = TRUE, boot = TRUE,
             runs = 1000, ci = 0.95)
  plot(res, main = paste("IRF:", impulse_var, "->", response_var))
  return(res)
}

irf_bi_inf   <- buat_irf(var_model, "d_birate", "inflasi")
irf_lnk_inf  <- buat_irf(var_model, "d_lnkurs", "inflasi")
irf_inf_bi   <- buat_irf(var_model, "inflasi",  "d_birate")
irf_inf_lnk  <- buat_irf(var_model, "inflasi",  "d_lnkurs")
irf_bi_lnk   <- buat_irf(var_model, "d_birate", "d_lnkurs")
irf_lnk_bi   <- buat_irf(var_model, "d_lnkurs", "d_birate")

# --- Tabel numerik IRF ---
tabel_irf <- function(res_irf, impulse_var, response_var) {
  data.frame(
    Periode  = 0:24,
    Response = as.numeric(res_irf$irf[[impulse_var]][, response_var]),
    Lower    = as.numeric(res_irf$Lower[[impulse_var]][, response_var]),
    Upper    = as.numeric(res_irf$Upper[[impulse_var]][, response_var])
  )
}

tabel_irf_bi_inf  <- tabel_irf(irf_bi_inf,  "d_birate", "inflasi")
tabel_irf_lnk_inf <- tabel_irf(irf_lnk_inf, "d_lnkurs", "inflasi")
tabel_irf_inf_bi  <- tabel_irf(irf_inf_bi,  "inflasi",  "d_birate")
tabel_irf_inf_lnk <- tabel_irf(irf_inf_lnk, "inflasi",  "d_lnkurs")

cat("\n--- IRF: Shock BI Rate -> Inflasi ---\n");  print(head(tabel_irf_bi_inf, 10))
cat("\n--- IRF: Shock Kurs -> Inflasi ---\n");     print(head(tabel_irf_lnk_inf, 10))
cat("\n--- IRF: Shock Inflasi -> BI Rate ---\n");  print(head(tabel_irf_inf_bi, 10))
cat("\n--- IRF: Shock Inflasi -> Kurs ---\n");     print(head(tabel_irf_inf_lnk, 10))

# Forecast Error Variance Decomposition (FEVD)
fevd_result <- fevd(var_model, n.ahead = 24)

rapikan_fevd <- function(mat, target) {
  df <- as.data.frame(mat)
  colnames(df) <- c("shock_inflasi", "shock_birate", "shock_lnkurs")
  df$periode <- 1:nrow(df)
  df$target  <- target
  df[, c("target", "periode",
         "shock_inflasi", "shock_birate", "shock_lnkurs")]
}

fevd_inf <- rapikan_fevd(fevd_result$inflasi,      "Inflasi")
fevd_bi  <- rapikan_fevd(fevd_result$d_birate,     "D.BI Rate")
fevd_lnk <- rapikan_fevd(fevd_result$d_lnkurs,     "D.ln Kurs")

cat("\n--- FEVD Inflasi ---\n");  print(head(fevd_inf, 10))
cat("\n--- FEVD BI Rate ---\n");  print(head(fevd_bi, 10))
cat("\n--- FEVD ln Kurs ---\n");  print(head(fevd_lnk, 10))


plot(fevd_result)


cat("LAPORAN ANALISIS VAR - INFLASI, BI RATE, KURS\n")
cat("============================================================\n\n")

cat("=== 1. STATISTIK DESKRIPTIF ===\n")
print(stat_desc)
cat("\n=== 2. ADF LEVEL ===\n")
print(summary(adf_inf_lvl$drift))
print(summary(adf_bir_lvl$drift))
print(summary(adf_lnk_lvl$drift))
cat("\n=== 3. ADF FIRST DIFFERENCE ===\n")
print(summary(adf_bir_diff$drift))
print(summary(adf_lnk_diff$drift))
cat("\n=== 4. PP & KPSS ===\n")
print(summary(pp_kpss_bir_diff$pp))
print(summary(pp_kpss_bir_diff$kpss))
print(summary(pp_kpss_lnk_diff$pp))
print(summary(pp_kpss_lnk_diff$kpss))
cat("\n=== 5. JOHANSEN (TRACE) ===\n")
print(summary(joh_trace))
cat("\n=== 6. JOHANSEN (EIGEN) ===\n")
print(summary(joh_eigen))
cat("\n=== 7. LAG OPTIMAL ===\n")            
print(lag_select$selection)
cat("\n=== 8. ESTIMASI VAR ===\n")
print(summary(var_model))
cat("\n=== 9. STABILITAS ===\n")
print(Mod(roots_val))
cat("\n=== 10. DIAGNOSTIK ===\n")
print(serial_test)
print(normality_test)
print(arch_test)
cat("\n=== 11. IRF: BI Rate -> Inflasi ===\n") 
print(tabel_irf_bi_inf)
cat("\n=== 12. IRF: Kurs -> Inflasi ===\n")
print(tabel_irf_lnk_inf)
cat("\n=== 13. IRF: Inflasi -> BI Rate ===\n")
print(tabel_irf_inf_bi)
cat("\n=== 14. IRF: Inflasi -> Kurs ===\n")
print(tabel_irf_inf_lnk)
cat("\n=== 15. FEVD Inflasi ===\n")
print(fevd_inf)
cat("\n=== 16. FEVD BI Rate ===\n")
print(fevd_bi)
cat("\n=== 17. FEVD ln Kurs ===\n")
print(fevd_lnk)



```
